title: Cristaux et cohomologie de De Rham : généralités, correspondances Deligne et Berthelot (1965-1969) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), lettre (1965).

errors: Implicit hypothesis: for $\widetilde X\to e$ to be a covering, every object (U,T,δ) must locally admit a retraction T→X over S. This needs X smooth (formally smooth) over S. That is the setting of stratifications, but it is not stated on the page.

The vanishing of $H^q$ for q>0 on an ind-object needs $R^1\varprojlim=0$. This holds here because the transition maps are closed immersions of affines, so they are surjective on sections (Mittag-Leffler), but the point is not addressed.
The input $H^q(\widetilde{(U,U')},\mathcal O)=H^q(U',\mathcal O_{U'})$ is itself flagged 'à vérifier' on p.29.

ideas.what: Crystalline/PD-stratified cohomology of O computed as the cohomology of the cosimplicial ring of (completed) PD-envelopes of the diagonals of $X^{\nu+1}$
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (infinitesimal version, 'Crystals and the de Rham cohomology of schemes', 1968); Berthelot (Cohomologie cristalline, LNM 407, 1974); made systematic by Bhatt–de Jong (2011) and the Stacks Project
ideas.where_published: Dix exposés sur la cohomologie des schémas, 'Crystals and the de Rham cohomology of schemes' (1968), for the infinitesimal case with formal completions of the diagonal; the PD variant is indicated there and developed by Berthelot

ideas.what: Globalisation: $H^*(X_{crys},\mathcal O)=\mathbb H^*(X_{Zar},\mathcal E^*)$ with $\mathcal E^*$ a cosimplicial $\mathcal O_X$-augmented PD-algebra
ideas.modern_name: Comparison of crystalline cohomology with Zariski hypercohomology of a Čech–Alexander (or de Rham–PD) complex
ideas.where_published: Spirit of 'Crystals and de Rham cohomology' (1968); precise form in Berthelot 1974

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working draft of the standard Čech–Alexander computation of crystalline cohomology. It is announced in Grothendieck's 1968 Crystals exposé and carried out in Berthelot's thesis. Nothing appears absent from the literature, though the double-index (i,j) ind-presentation is a pleasant early explicit form.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'DR-' is written above 'stratifiant' as an insertion ('site DR-stratifiant'); 'stratifiant' is not crossed out.
The limit is written 'lim' with a left-pointing arrow indexed by i,j, i.e. $\varprojlim_{i,j}$. The pieces are $\Delta^{(\nu)}_{X/S}(i)(j)$, not $(i,(j))$.
'X → affine' is probably 'X est affine' (or 'X/S affine').
General case: likely 'Dans le cas général, on trouve un anneau cosimplicial $\mathcal O_X$-augmenté à puissances divisées, soit $\mathcal E^*$, et ...'.
